title: {p} Tikka Masala
steps: Season the {p} with the {spice} and sear in a hot pan with a little oil until browned on the outside, then set aside on a clean plate.
Soften a little garlic in the same pan, add the {v}, then pour in the {sauce} and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve over the {s} with a squeeze of lemon.
tip: Use tomato with a little cream or yogurt instead of all cream, and add extra veg to stretch it.
